items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The name 'Stan' appears in the transcript only as a form of address by the Interviewer to the Interviewee (e.g., 'I thought so, Stan', 'let me see what I might say, Stan'). There is no mention of a person named Ken Stan as a third party.

ctx.x: Well, were your parents musical at all?
Well, Stan, I thought so. My mother sang in the choir. She had not a trained voice but a very plaintive voice and I had it had something to say
